summary: Explicit repository namespaces preserve continuity history

delivery.outcome: Initialize an explicit digest-bound repository continuity namespace while preserving the complete legacy journal; publish the managed helper and version0.20.148.
nonGoals: No repository alias authorization or event rebinding
No consumer adoption, deployment, lease or protected policy changes

architecture.decision: Keep legacy storage as default. An explicit init-namespace operation validates the complete expected legacy chain and stream digest, then atomically installs a repository-derived advisory selector using the existing anchored storage transaction. Selected storage never aliases repositories or grants authority.
dataChanges: Optional advisory per-repository selector and isolated ignored journal/index; preserve legacy bytes.
architecture.rollback: Reviewed source revert; retain all legacy and namespaced journals and selectors for separately authorized recovery.

validation.evidence: Real CLI changed-origin reproduction, read-only planning, explicit activation, replay and current capture/resolve/verify.
Wrong digest/repository, malformed or occupied selection, links, interrupted publication, idempotency and contention preserve original history.
Managed package includes helper, canonical documentation/index and version148 agree; independent protected exact-head CI and Validator gate publication.
